hero.headline: End-to-end building security with the BCM system
hero.intro: Smart and flexible access control for every area of your property

bcm.label: BCM system
bcm.title: The BCM system from TCS
bcm.text: The BCM system from TCS provides a comprehensive digital solution for modern access control and building management. It combines maximum security with maximum convenience and makes it possible to effectively secure residential and commercial properties. From flexible door and lift control through intelligent locking systems for storage facilities to convenient mobile access via smartphone – BCM protects critical areas in a targeted manner and manages access rights precisely and ready for the future.

tuerenTore.headline: 1. Access control for doors and gates
tuerenTore.text: Reliable protection for outdoor and indoor areas: By using modern reading and input devices, the BCM system controls access at doors and gates – both outdoors and inside a building – securely and precisely. Doors are opened conveniently via transponder key or PIN code. To meet every structural requirement precisely, the portfolio includes a wide range of products such as electronic door handle sets, knob cylinders and BCM online readers.

fahrstuhl.headline: 2. Intelligent lift control
fahrstuhl.text: Targeted floor release for authorised persons: To increase security in multi-storey properties, access control can be integrated directly into lifts. Especially in office and administrative buildings, hotels or apartment houses, access to individual floors can be precisely controlled. Floor access in the lifts is then granted securely and traceably via electronic key instead of by simply pressing a button.

schraenkeContainer.headline: 3. Electronic locking systems for cabinets and containers
schraenkeContainer.text: Seamless opening control for storage facilities: Beyond classic doors, the system also offers optimal security through detailed opening control of storage facilities. Outdoors, access to bicycle or container parking areas can be effectively controlled with electronic padlocks. Inside the building, cabinets, lockers or sensitive functional facilities such as server racks are reliably protected against unauthorised access by intelligent electronic cabinet locks.

mobilerZutritt.headline: 4. Mobile access via Door App or phone call
mobilerZutritt.text: The smartphone as a smart and flexible key: For maximum convenience, the BCM system enables keyless access directly via the mobile device. With the intelligent BCM DoorApp, the smartphone becomes a secure key for online and offline doors via Bluetooth (BLE) or NFC. Alternatively, the integrated GSM gateway makes it possible to grant access conveniently via a simple phone call or text message from a registered phone number, without the need for transponder cards. This is particularly useful, for example, to grant visitors or suppliers access for a limited time window.

hero.headline: Access with Phone Call
